role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 幻影长矛手操控源源不断的复制体展开攻势，让敌人应接不暇。带领着他的幻象大军，密集的攻击将撕裂敌阵，使对手喘不过气来，还能派出分身向敌方推进，一旦局势不妙就运用神形百变迷惑对手，逃之夭夭。
hero_summary_en: Phantom Lancer storms enemy forces with an endless supply of clones. Leading his illusory army, he can cut foes apart in a breathtaking flurry of attacks, send clones to push into enemy territory, or use his doppelgangers to mislead and elude foes if cornered.

abilities.name: phantom_lancer_spirit_lance
abilities.description_zh: 对敌方目标单位投出一支有魔力的灵魂之矛，造成伤害并减速，同时召唤一个幻象攻击该单位。
abilities.description_en: Sends a magical spirit lance to a target enemy unit that damages and slows, while summoning an illusory phantom to attack the unit.
notes_zh: 幻影长矛手附近%fake_lance_distance%范围内的幻象也会模仿施法动作。
notes_en: Illusions within %fake_lance_distance% range of Phantom Lancer will mimic the cast animation.

scepter_loc.en: Spirit Lance bounces once on enemies, prioritizing Heroes. Increases Spirit Lance illusion damage.
scepter_loc.zh: 灵魂之矛可以向范围内敌人弹射一次，以英雄优先。提升灵魂之矛的幻象继承攻击力。

facet_text_en: Spirit Lances from Phantom Lancer's illusions deal %illusion_lance_damage_pct%%% Lance Damage.
facet_text_zh: 幻影长矛手幻象放出的灵魂之矛会造成%illusion_lance_damage_pct%%%长矛伤害。

abilities.name: phantom_lancer_doppelwalk
abilities.description_zh:
幻影长矛手暂时从战场上消失。经过%delay%秒，幻影长矛手和附近的所有幻象都会出现在目标地点的随机位置，并产生两个新的幻象。施放技能后延长所有幻象的持续时间。新加的两个幻象拥有不同的特性：一个承受正常百分比的伤害，不具有攻击力，另一个额外承受%illusion_2_damage_in_pct%%%伤害，继承的攻击力相比本体减少%illusion_2_damage_out_pct%%%。

驱散类型：弱驱散
abilities.description_en:
Phantom Lancer briefly vanishes from the battlefield. After %delay% second, Phantom Lancer and any of his nearby illusions reappear at a random position within the targeted location, along with two additional doppelgangers. Extends duration of all illusions. The two added doppelgangers have different properties: one takes normal damage and deals none, while the other takes %illusion_2_damage_in_pct%%% bonus damage and deals %illusion_2_damage_out_pct%%% less damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 这个技能可以躲避攻击和技能弹道，并且驱散负面效果。
重新现身的单位附近的树木将会被摧毁。
幻影长矛手和他的队友可以分辨出哪个幻象承受100%伤害。
notes_en: This ability can be used to dodge projectiles, and dispel debuffs.
Trees near a reappearing unit will be destroyed.
Phantom Lancer and his allies can see which illusion is the 100% damage illusion.
facet_text_en: Spawns an additional illusion per %hp_missing_per_extra_illusion_pct%%% of health that Phantom Lancer is missing.
facet_text_zh: 幻影长矛手每缺失%hp_missing_per_extra_illusion_pct%%%生命都会额外产生一个幻象。

abilities.name: phantom_lancer_phantom_edge
abilities.description_zh: 对目标发动攻击后，幻影长矛手将快速向其冲去，获得移动速度和闪避提升。
abilities.description_en: When targeting an enemy for an attack, Phantom Lancer quickly charges into range, gaining increased movement speed and evasion.
notes_zh: 如果冲锋中途取消攻击指令，那么移动速度加成就会消失。
冲锋过程中移动速度为%bonus_speed%。
notes_en: If the attack order is cancelled, the movement speed bonus is lost.

scepter_loc.en: Increases Range. Whenever Phantom Lancer Rushes through enemies, he creates Juxtapose illusions that attack them. Additionally, every %illusion_spawn_travel_distance% units rushed creates a Juxtapose illusion that rushes to the target alongside Phantom Lancer.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升距离。每当幻影长矛手冲锋时穿过敌人，他就会制造并列幻象攻击他们。另外，每冲锋%illusion_spawn_travel_distance%距离还会在幻影长矛手身旁制造一个并列幻象，向目标冲去。

abilities.name: phantom_lancer_illusory_armaments
abilities.description_zh: 幻影长矛手只要制造出幻象，该幻象的继承攻击力不会低于一定值，持续%duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Whenever an illusion of Phantom Lancer is created, its outgoing damage cannot go below a fixed value for %duration% seconds.

abilities.name: phantom_lancer_juxtapose
abilities.description_zh: 幻影长矛手的攻击有一定几率使自己的存在破碎，产生自身的幻象。幻象也有几率进一步破碎，再产生幻象。幻影长矛手产生的幻象持续%illusion_duration%秒，幻象产生的幻象则持续%illusion_from_illusion_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Phantom Lancer has a chance to fracture his presence on an attack, creating an illusion of himself. Illusions also have a chance to fracture further. Illusions created from Phantom Lancer last for %illusion_duration% seconds, while illusions created from other illusions last %illusion_from_illusion_duration% seconds.

shard_loc.en: Adds an active ability to Juxtapose. Renders Phantom Lancer invisible for up to %invis_duration% seconds while generating a duplicate image to confuse enemies. His movement speed is increased by %invis_movespeed%%% during this invisibility.
shard_loc.zh: 并列增加主动技能。使幻影长矛手进入隐身，最多持续%invis_duration%秒，同时产生一个复制幻象来迷惑敌人。隐身期间自身移动速度提升%invis_movespeed%%%。

facet_text_en: Juxtapose Illusions spawn on random nearby units and deal more damage but can't be controlled.
facet_text_zh: 并列的幻象会在附近随机单位身旁产生，继承更高的攻击力，但是无法控制。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_phantom_lancer_illusion_lances
talents_raw.desc_loc: Spirit Lances from illusions hit for a percentage of the normal damage amount
